title: buildHistory
responsibility: Builds the portable history index for a repository into an output directory.

inputs.name: buildHistory.options
inputs.description: Optional configuration for the repository root, history output directory, and newest-commit limit. The root defaults to the current working directory, the output path is resolved from the root and must be given, and the limit defaults to 2000 and must convert to a positive whole number.

inputs.name: renderBuild.built
inputs.description: A built history result containing the output path, SHA-256 digest, media counts, problems, history index, and SQLite catalog path. It is consumed by renderBuild to produce the text summary.

outputs.name: buildHistory
outputs.description: Resolves to the built history result containing the output path, digest, media counts, problems, index data, and SQLite catalog path. The build reads repository Git history, requires a Git repository and an output directory, and includes the requested number of newest commits, defaulting to 2000.

outputs.name: renderBuild
outputs.description: Text summary of a built history result, including the output path, 12-character digest prefix, SQLite catalog path, revision coverage counts, media counts, and any problems. The lines are joined with newline characters.
examples:
History index written to /workspace/repo/.harness/history (0123456789ab).
SQLite catalog: /workspace/repo/.harness/history/catalog.sqlite.
0 commits: 0 verified, 0 failed, 0 invalid, 0 without evidence.
Media: 0 resolved, 0 missing.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by buildHistory when the resolved root is not a Git repository, the output directory is missing, or the supplied limit does not convert to a positive whole number.
